name: Indian Institute of Management Bangalore, Executive Post Graduate Programme in Management (EPGP, MBA)

tuition_total.note: Tuition covers course material, computing, library, alumni association, student activities, career counselling. 2026-27 figures read in a search-engine extract of the official page (the page returns 403 to curl and WebFetch). Same INR 26,50,000 tuition in the official EPGP 2025-26 fee table (brochure PDF, sources/iim-bangalore-epgp-brochure-2026-27.pdf).

mandatory_fees_total.note: Value = International Immersion (part of the programme, indicative INR 5,50,000, limited to actual travel, accommodation and partner-school fees). Refundable deposit (INR 25,000) not added. Official 2026-27 total with hostel: INR 33,68,000; without hostel: 32,20,000 (search extract). 2025-26 brochure total: 33,71,000 (hostel) / 36,62,000 (family accommodation outside campus).

living_budget_total.note: Only the fees billed by IIMB (hostel and mess); no budget for personal expenses published. 2025-26: hostel 80,000, mess 66,000; family accommodation outside campus 3,76,000.

scholarship.note: Merit scholarship: INR 8,00,000 tuition waiver for top rank holders of each admission round, 12 awards (search extract of the official page). An older IIMB PDF (https://www.iimb.ac.in/sites/default/files/inline-files/EPGP_Scholarships.pdf) describes different amounts; not used.

placement_pool.note: IIMB does not state how many sought placement; 61 offers accepted out of 73 students (66 after removing opted-out and sabbatical). No time frame given.

base_salary.note: 'Summary of Compensation (in lakhs) per annum: Median Salary 36.50, Average Salary 37.10'. Components (fixed vs variable) not specified; report not IPRS-audited.

by_industry_meta.basis: 'Top Industries for EPGP Placements' (% of placements)

by_function_meta.note: No function split published for EPGP.

by_geography_meta.note: No location split published for EPGP (the PGP report counts 7 overseas offers for the two-year PGP, not EPGP).

employment.top_employers_note: Alphabetical 'List of Recruiters - EPGP' (22 companies), no offer counts.

profile.note: 73 students; 26% 'with international experience' (not the share of foreign nationals). No average age or average experience published in the brochure.

rankings_cited.note: Title of the IIMB Digest (official) article, seen in search results.

notes: www.iimb.ac.in HTML pages answer 403 to curl and WebFetch (anti-bot); the PDFs under /sites/default/files download fine. 2026-27 fee and scholarship figures come from a search extract of the official fee page and should be re-read in a browser.
